definitions.explanation: Expresses purpose or goal; used to indicate doing something with the aim of achieving a certain state.
Used to make comparisons or describe similarity.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくても、{日課|にっか}だけは{欠|か}かさないようにしている。
examples.english: Even when busy, I make sure not to miss my daily routine.
examples.notes: Purpose usage with している

examples.japanese: {忘|わす}れないようにメモする。
examples.english: I take notes so that I don't forget.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}かないように{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful not to catch a cold.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}のように{空|そら}を{飛|と}びたい。
examples.english: I want to fly through the sky like a bird.

notes:
GRAMMAR PATTERNS:

1. PURPOSE (〜ように):
・V(dictionary/ない) + ように (so that V / so that not V)
・{間|ま}に{合|あ}うように{早|はや}く{出|で}る (leave early so as to be on time)
・{忘|わす}れないようにする (make sure not to forget)

2. COMPARISON (〜のように):
・N + のように (like N)
・{子|こ}どものように (like a child)
・{言|い}ったように (as I said)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・ようにする (to make sure to, to try to)
・ようになる (to come to, to become able to)
・ように{言|い}う (to tell someone to)

DISTINCTION:
・ように (purpose/manner) - this entry
・ために (purpose/reason) - implies more direct causation
